name: tailrocks-repository-skills
description: Target-bound repository orchestration plus fail-closed pull-request creation, refresh, review, documentation, templates, landing, audit, and cleanup.

interface.shortDescription: Target-aware repository coordination, audit, and cleanup.
interface.longDescription: tailrocks-repository-merge audits selected sources against one exact destination, while the bundled pull-request skills create, refresh, review, document, template, and land changes under explicit gates; audit and cleanup remain independently callable.
defaultPrompt: Coordinate these sources into the exact selected repository target.
Review, create, refresh, document, template, or merge this pull request under its gates.
Audit these repository sources against the selected target.
Clean up these resolved sources only after their evidence is verified.
